8.title: Progress Budget Current Month
8.description:
# Tile Description

**Current Month DPS Budget Status** — Displays your monthly DPS spending against the budget limit with real-time percentage utilization, helping you monitor cost consumption and avoid budget overruns.

---

**Why this gauge visualization works:**
- Gauges excel at showing progress toward a threshold (budget limit)
- The `budgetPct` field maps naturally to gauge fill, making overspend immediately visible
- `budgetStatus` provides context on whether you're within or exceeding limits
- Single-value focus (latest month via `limit 1`) keeps the display clean and actionable

If you want help with creating DQL queries, ask your admin to enable Agentic AI.

fetch bizevents
| filter event.provider == "dps.cost.current.month"
  and event.type == "dps.cost.monthly.budget"
| sort runId desc
| limit 1
| fields month, total, budgetLimit, budgetStatus, budgetPct, currencyCode, runId
